Investigate the deployable unit service:com.crm:api-gateway.

The deployable units of the system:
- service:com.crm.auth:auth-service, named auth-service, in the repository Auth-Service
- service:com.crm.notification:notification-service, named notification-service, in the repository Notification-Service
- service:com.crm:api-gateway, named api-gateway, in the repository Discovery-and-Gateway
- service:com.crm:eureka-service, named eureka-service, in the repository Discovery-and-Gateway
- service:com.crm:file, named file-service, in the repository File-Service
- service:org.springframework.boot:main-service, named main-service, in the repository Main-Service

predicate.description: Only facts with this predicate, such as endpoint

tools.name: read_file

to.description: The last line; at most 200 lines a read
